title: Senior Frontend Engineer, Marketing Website
sponsorshipEvidence: We can also accommodate remote workers elsewhere in Europe subject to compliance and right to work checks.

eligibility.reason: Role requires being in London or elsewhere in Europe with right-to-work checks, employed via OysterHR; no sponsorship offered.

mustHave.text: At least 5 years as software engineer, incl. 3 at senior level on content-driven/marketing front end
Real ownership of a content model in Sanity; GROQ and Portable Text familiar
Expert HTML, CSS and TypeScript; component API design
End-to-end: SSR, serverless and edge runtimes, API routes, SQL database, secrets, CI
Responsive design, cross-browser, web performance, WCAG 2.2 AA
Accountable to performance, SEO, analytics and conversion metrics
Strong sense of craft and attention to detail

niceToHave.text: Prior experience on a large SaaS marketing website
Cloudflare Workers or another edge/serverless platform
Tailwind CSS v4 and token-based design systems
Making component libraries and content models consumable by AI agents
